integrity: The proof reconstructs the Poisson image directly from the Fourier series, sums the fourth moment analytically, and proves positivity by a finite Bernstein-basis certificate. The executable verifier checks the two finite polynomial identities exactly with rational arithmetic; it is not used as a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the explicit unimodular one-parameter family used for the supercritical obstruction. It does not prove the full complex endpoint conjecture, does not address arbitrary perturbations, and does not settle the centered nonzero-mean conjecture.
title: Exact endpoint deficit for the canonical complex Poisson obstruction family
